SkillEvaluator

Run the SkillEvaluator CLI on agent skills and report what the evidence shows: Tier 1 validation (static, security, quality), Tier 2 deduplication, and Tier 3 live agent evaluation that compares runs with and without the skill.

Purpose

Give an agent one reliable procedure for evaluating skills with SkillEvaluator: pick the right tier, check readiness, run it, and report scores, findings and exit codes truthfully.
